meta.description: Registry for explicit universal, existential, bounded, conditional, and local quantifier scopes.

scope_classes.meaning: Applies to all elements in the declared domain.
Applies to at least one element in the declared domain.
Applies to all elements in a restricted or bounded domain satisfying explicit conditions.
Applies to at least one element in a restricted or bounded domain satisfying explicit conditions.
Applies only within a specific local context, neighborhood, or CSI domain.
Application depends on explicit residue, orientation, or admissibility predicates.
